title: gradient.rs: Zero-capacity table panics on insert
description: GradientTable::new(0) followed by update() causes panic at line 237. When max_entries=0, the condition at line 236 (self.entries.len() >= self.max_entries) is true (0 >= 0), triggering self.entries.remove(0) on an empty Vec, which panics with 'index out of bounds'. Fix: add early return when max_entries==0, or clamp min capacity to 1.
close_reason: GradientTable::update now explicitly rejects zero-capacity tables with false before eviction, preserving zero allocation and preventing remove(0) panic. Added zero/one capacity tests covering repeated updates, exact capacity, lookups, iteration, removal, expiry, replacement, and eviction. lichen-node tests, rustfmt, Clippy -D warnings, and no-default-features check all pass.
